heading: Privacy Policy
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy describes how Arseen Enterprises LLC ('Company,' 'we,' 'us,' or 'our'), a Wyoming limited liability company (US Office Address: 15 Tanguay Ave, Suite 112 #7C, Nashua, NH 03063, United States), collects, uses, discloses, and safeguards information obtained from clients, prospective clients, and visitors to our website. By accessing our website or engaging our services, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.

Information We Collect. We collect information in two primary ways: (1) information you provide directly to us, and (2) information collected automatically when you interact with our website or services. Directly provided information may include your full name, business name, email address, phone number, mailing and billing addresses, tax identification numbers, shipment details (including consignee names and destination addresses), and any other information you submit through contact forms, inquiry submissions, or service agreements. Payment and billing information associated with customer transactions is also collected. Where electronic payments are accepted, payment card and account information is processed exclusively by authorized third-party payment processors. Arseen Enterprises LLC does not store, access, or retain full payment card numbers, bank account credentials, or payment account passwords on its own servers. Automatically collected information may include IP addresses, browser type and version, operating system, referring URLs, pages visited, time spent on pages, and device identifiers.

How We Use Your Information. We use the information we collect for the following purposes: (a) to provide, operate, and improve our custom product procurement, order fulfillment, shipment coordination, and related customer services; (b) to process payments and manage billing; (c) to communicate with you regarding your orders, shipments, order and payment status, and support requests; (d) to comply with applicable legal obligations, including customs, export control, sanctions, and anti-money-laundering regulations; (e) to detect, prevent, and investigate fraud, security incidents, or other prohibited activities; (f) to send transactional and service-related communications; (g) to analyze usage trends and improve our website and service offerings; and (h) to enforce our Terms of Service and other agreements.

Legal Bases for Processing (GDPR). For individuals located in the European Economic Area (EEA) or the United Kingdom, we process personal data under the following legal bases: (a) Performance of a Contract — processing is necessary to fulfill our service obligations to you; (b) Legal Obligation — processing is required to comply with applicable laws and regulations; (c) Legitimate Interests — processing is necessary for our legitimate business interests, such as fraud prevention and service improvement, provided those interests are not overridden by your rights; and (d) Consent — where we have obtained your explicit consent for specific processing activities, such as marketing communications. You may withdraw consent at any time by contacting us at support@arseenenterprises.com.

Cookies and Tracking Technologies. Our website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and support certain website functions. Cookies are small text files stored on your device. We use the following categories of cookies: (a) Strictly Necessary Cookies, which are required for the website to function and cannot be disabled; (b) Analytics Cookies, which help us understand how visitors interact with our website by collecting and reporting information anonymously; and (c) Preference Cookies, which allow the website to remember choices you make. You may control cookie settings through your browser preferences. Disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of our website. We do not currently respond to Do Not Track (DNT) browser signals.

Third-Party Sharing and Disclosure. We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties for their own marketing purposes. We may share your information with trusted third parties only in the following circumstances: (a) Payment Processors — payment card and electronic payment account information is transmitted to and processed by authorized third-party payment processors who are contractually obligated to protect your information and comply with applicable payment security standards; (b) Service Providers — we engage third-party vendors to assist with shipping carriers, customs brokers, cloud hosting, and analytics, who are contractually obligated to protect your information and use it only for the purposes we specify; (c) Legal Compliance — we may disclose information when required by law, court order, or governmental authority, including customs and border protection agencies; (d) Business Transfers — in the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction, subject to equivalent privacy protections; and (e) Protection of Rights — we may disclose information to protect the rights, property, or safety of Arseen Enterprises LLC, our clients, or others.

International Data Transfers. As a company providing custom product procurement and international order fulfillment services, we operate across multiple jurisdictions. Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries outside your country of residence, including the United States and other countries in which our suppliers, logistics providers, and service partners operate, which may have different data protection laws. By using our services, you consent to the transfer of your information to the United States and other countries as described in this policy.

Data Storage and Security. We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. Payment card and electronic payment information is processed through authorized third-party payment processors and is not stored on our servers. While we take reasonable precautions, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security. In the event of a data breach that affects your rights and freedoms, we will notify affected individuals and relevant authorities as required by applicable law.

Data Retention. We retain personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Privacy Policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law. Specifically: (a) customer, order, transaction, invoice, and fulfillment records are retained for a minimum of seven (7) years to comply with tax, accounting, and customs recordkeeping requirements; (b) shipment and fulfillment records may be retained longer where required by international trade regulations; (c) marketing consent records are retained until consent is withdrawn plus an additional three (3) years; and (d) website analytics data is retained in aggregated, anonymized form. Sanctions, restricted-party screening, and related compliance records may be retained for longer periods where required by applicable sanctions, export-control, payment-provider, or other legal requirements. When personal information is no longer needed, we securely delete or anonymize it.

Your Rights. Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the following rights regarding your personal information: (a) Right of Access — the right to request a copy of the personal information we hold about you; (b) Right to Rectification — the right to request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information; (c) Right to Erasure ('Right to Be Forgotten') — the right to request deletion of your personal information, subject to legal retention obligations; (d) Right to Restriction of Processing — the right to request that we limit how we use your information; (e) Right to Data Portability — the right to receive your information in a structured, machine-readable format; (f) Right to Object — the right to object to processing based on legitimate interests or for direct marketing; and (g) Right to Non-Discrimination (CCPA) — California residents have the right not to receive discriminatory treatment for exercising their privacy rights. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at support@arseenenterprises.com. We will respond to verified requests within 30 days (or 45 days where permitted by law).

California Privacy Rights (CCPA/CPRA). California residents are entitled to additional rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA). In the preceding 12 months, we have not sold personal information. We have not shared personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising. Categories of personal information we collect include identifiers, commercial information, internet activity, and professional/employment information. You may submit a verifiable consumer request to know, delete, or correct your personal information by contacting us at support@arseenenterprises.com. We do not discriminate against consumers who exercise their CCPA rights.

Children's Privacy. Our services are available to both business clients and individual consumers. We do not knowingly collect personal information from individuals under the age of 18. If we become aware that we have inadvertently collected personal information from a minor, we will take prompt steps to delete such information. If you believe we may have collected information from a minor, please contact us immediately at support@arseenenterprises.com.

Third-Party Links. Our website may contain links to third-party websites, payment portals, or carrier tracking systems. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those third-party sites. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any third-party sites you visit. The inclusion of a link does not imply our endorsement of that site or its privacy practices.

Policy Updates. We reserve the right to update or modify this Privacy Policy at any time to reflect changes in our practices, legal requirements, or business operations. When we make material changes, we will update the 'Last Updated' date at the top of this policy and, where appropriate, notify clients by email or through a prominent notice on our website. Your continued use of our services after any changes constitutes your acceptance of the updated Privacy Policy. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

Contact Us. If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at: Arseen Enterprises LLC, Email: support@arseenenterprises.com. US Office Address: 15 Tanguay Ave, Suite 112 #7C, Nashua, NH 03063, United States. We are committed to resolving privacy-related concerns promptly and transparently.
